insurgent_pressure_regeneration: Underground disruption obeys exact exponential stock decay while remaining instantaneously separated from fielded force.
Recruitment hazard factors exactly into configured rate, eligible stock, and mean mobilization/access intensity.
Recruitment realization is finite-subcohort stochastic sampling.
Fighter regeneration generates an exact supply-capital burden and high mobilization produces a replicated leverage/ruin frontier.
state_force_generation: Security recruitment passes through an exact exponential training pipeline and attriting trained reserve.
Under recurring constant intake, training speed controls transient lag but long-run graduation converges exactly to intake.
Reserve attrition sets the sustainable long-run deployment ceiling at b*N per interval.
Authorized-strength caps prevent indefinite absorption into full formations.
Lower-experience replacement means nominal headcount recovery can leave a persistent capability deficit.
combat_human_capital: Replacement share dilutes veterancy by exact weighted memory.
Experience changes capability through a fixed linear factor and uncapped combat exchange through exact elasticities.
organizational_stochasticity: Conditional recruitment and organization-collapse distributions are exactly specified, explaining stochastic branches around deterministic local laws.
structural_theory.emergent_phase_result: The repaired fresh 24-seed mobilization frontier supports a probabilistic leverage/ruin regime with a low-rate stochastic-collapse floor and a rate-linked capital-exhaustion branch.

claim_boundary: All twelve laws are mathematical/stochastic laws of implemented Pineland mechanisms. Their coefficients, timescales, and synthetic phase boundaries are not empirical laws of real conflict.
